answer: Hardware enclave attestation mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to present a cryptographic quote from a secure coprocessor. Instead of unleashing a raven flock of cheap clones, an attacker must pass an admission inlet with constraints as strict as a sonnet. The verifiable cost per identity is procuring specialized physical silicon chips. A key limitation is that compromised manufacturer keys allow attackers to forge valid identities on a single compromised machine.
